name: farkas_literal_vacuous
doc:
**任务书原始命题（逐字复现）**：
`{x | ∀ i, dotV (a i) x ≤ 0} = ∅ ⟹ ∃ λ ≥ 0, (∀ j, ∑ i, λᵢ aᵢⱼ = 0) ∧ 0 < ∑ λᵢ`。

**诚实标注：前提不可满足**（`0` 恒在该集合中，见 `nonpos_set_nonempty`），
因此本命题是**空真**的假言命题，**不是有内容的 Farkas 引理**。
其证明只是从前提导出 `False`（`0 ∈ ∅`）。
stmt:
theorem farkas_literal_vacuous {m d : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin d → ℝ)) :
    ({x : Fin d → ℝ | ∀ i, dotV (a i) x ≤ 0} = ∅ →
      ∃ lam : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) ∧
        (∀ j, (∑ i, lam i * a i j) = 0) ∧ 0 < ∑ i, lam i)
proof:
by
  intro h
  have h0 := nonpos_set_nonempty a
  rw [h] at h0
  exact absurd h0 (by simp)

name: hasNonnegCombo_iff_sum
doc:
**坐标形式与「向量和」形式的等价**：
`HasNonnegCombo grad b ↔ ∃ λ ≥ 0, b = ∑ i, λᵢ • grad i`。
stmt:
theorem hasNonnegCombo_iff_sum {m d : ℕ} {grad : Fin m → (Fin d → ℝ)} {b : Fin d → ℝ} :
    HasNonnegCombo grad b ↔
      ∃ lam : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) ∧ b = ∑ i, lam i • grad i
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨lam, hlam, hb⟩
    refine ⟨lam, hlam, ?_⟩
    funext j
    rw [hb j, Finset.sum_apply]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · rintro ⟨lam, hlam, hb⟩
    refine ⟨lam, hlam, fun j => ?_⟩
    rw [hb, Finset.sum_apply]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: grad_mem_nonnegComboCone
doc: **每个生成元都属于非负组合锥**：`grad i ∈ cone{grad j}`（取 `λ = eᵢ`）。
stmt:
theorem grad_mem_nonnegComboCone {m d : ℕ} (grad : Fin m → (Fin d → ℝ)) (i : Fin m) :
    grad i ∈ nonnegComboCone grad
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun k => if k = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0, fun k => ?_, fun j => ?_⟩
  · by_cases h : k = i
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro k _ hk
      simp [hk]
    · intro hi
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi

name: zero_mem_of_closed_convexCone
stmt:
theorem zero_mem_of_closed_convexCone {d : ℕ} (K : ConvexCone ℝ (Fin d → ℝ))
    (hne : (K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)).Nonempty) (hc : IsClosed (K : Set (Fin d → ℝ))) :
    (0 : Fin d → ℝ) ∈ K
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
                                                        
                                                         
                              
  haveI hnb : (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] (0 : ℝ)).NeBot :=
    nhdsWithin_Ioi_neBot' ⟨1, by simp⟩ le_rfl
  refine IsClosed.mem_of_tendsto (f := fun t : ℝ => t • x)
    (b := 𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] (0 : ℝ)) hc ?_ ?_
  · have htend : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • x) (𝓝[Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 ((0 : ℝ) • x)) :=
      ((continuous_id.smul continuous_const).tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    simpa using htend
  · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
    exact K.smul_mem ht hx

name: farkas_alternative
doc:
**抽象 Farkas 引理（双极的 nontrivial 方向）**：设 `H` 是完备实内积空间，`K` 是非空闭凸锥。
若 `b` 满足「所有 `K` 的对偶锥元素对 `b` 取非负值」，则 `b ∈ K`（即 `K** ⊆ K`）。

证明：反设 `b ∉ K`，用 `ConvexCone.hyperplane_separation_of_nonempty_of_isClosed_of_nmem`
分离出 `y`：`∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ ⟪x, y⟫` 且 `⟪y, b⟫ < 0`，与假设给的 `0 ≤ ⟪b, y⟫` 矛盾
（`real_inner_comm`）。
stmt:
theorem farkas_alternative {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (K : ConvexCone ℝ H) (hne : (K : Set H).Nonempty)
    (hc : IsClosed (K : Set H)) {b : H}
    (h : ∀ y : H, (∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ ⟪x, y⟫) → 0 ≤ ⟪b, y⟫) : b ∈ K
proof:
by
  by_contra hb
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyb⟩ := K.hyperplane_separation_of_nonempty_of_isClosed_of_nmem hne hc hb
  have h1 := h y hy
  rw [real_inner_comm y b] at h1
  linarith

name: farkas_bipolar
doc:
**Farkas 双极形式**：非空闭凸锥 `K` 满足 `(K*)* = K`，其中 `K* = K.innerDualCone`。
直接回收 mathlib 的 `ConvexCone.innerDualCone_of_innerDualCone_eq_self`。
stmt:
theorem farkas_bipolar {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (K : ConvexCone ℝ H) (hne : (K : Set H).Nonempty)
    (hc : IsClosed (K : Set H)) :
    ((K : Set H).innerDualCone : Set H).innerDualCone = K
proof: ConvexCone.innerDualCone_of_innerDualCone_eq_self K hne hc

name: farkas_alternative_dotV
doc:
**有限维坐标形式 Farkas（隐式方向）**：对 `Fin d → ℝ` 上的非空闭凸锥 `K` 与 `b`，
若 `b` 被「`K` 的 `dotV`-对偶锥」合法化，则 `b ∈ K`。

证明：反设 `b ∉ K`，在有限维局部凸空间 `Fin d → ℝ` 上用
`geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point` 得分离泛函 `f`（`u` 满足 `∀ a ∈ K, f a < u < f b`）。
由 `K` 是锥且 `0 ∈ K`（`zero_mem_of_closed_convexCone`）得 `u > 0`；再用 `t • a ∈ K`
（`t > 0`）与 `f a` 无上界推出 `∀ a ∈ K, f a ≤ 0`。取
`y := -(fun j => f (farkasStdBasisVec j))`（`farkasStdBasisVec` 为 `e_j` 标准基，本文件的
`farkas_continuousLinearMap_eq_dotV` 把 `f` 写成 `dotV`），则 `∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ dotV x y`，
由假设得 `0 ≤ dotV b y = -f b`，与 `0 < f b` 矛盾。
stmt:
theorem farkas_alternative_dotV {d : ℕ} (K : ConvexCone ℝ (Fin d → ℝ))
    (hne : (K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)).Nonempty) (hc : IsClosed (K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)))
    {b : Fin d → ℝ} (h : ∀ y : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ dotV x y) → 0 ≤ dotV b y) :
    b ∈ K
proof:
by
  by_contra hb
  obtain ⟨f, u, hfu, hfb⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point K.convex hc hb
  have h0K : (0 : Fin d → ℝ) ∈ K := zero_mem_of_closed_convexCone K hne hc
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) < u := by
    have := hfu 0 h0K
    simpa using this
  have hle : ∀ a ∈ K, f a ≤ 0 := by
    intro a ha
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, u / f a < (n : ℝ) := exists_nat_gt (u / f a)
    have ht : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
                                                    
      have := (Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ))
      linarith
    have hmem : ((n : ℝ) + 1) • a ∈ K := K.smul_mem ht ha
    have hlt := hfu _ hmem
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hlt
    have h1 : u < (n : ℝ) * f a := by
      rw [div_lt_iff hneg] at hn
      exact hn
    nlinarith [hlt, h1, hneg]
  have hfbpos : (0 : ℝ) < f b := lt_trans hu hfb
  have hkey : ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ, f x = dotV (fun j => f (farkasStdBasisVec j)) x :=
    fun x => farkas_continuousLinearMap_eq_dotV f x
  have hy : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ dotV x (-(fun j => f (farkasStdBasisVec j))) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : f x ≤ 0 := hle x hx
    rw [dotV_neg_right, dotV_comm, ← hkey x]
    linarith
  have h2 := h (-(fun j => f (farkasStdBasisVec j))) hy
  have h3 : dotV b (-(fun j => f (farkasStdBasisVec j))) = -f b := by
    rw [dotV_neg_right, dotV_comm, ← hkey b]
  linarith

name: farkas_fin_conic
doc:
**有限维 Farkas 引理（`ℝ^d` 坐标形式，iff）**：对任意非空闭凸锥
`K ⊆ Fin d → ℝ`，
`(∀ y, (∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ dotV x y) → 0 ≤ dotV b y) ↔ b ∈ K`。
正向（`b ∈ K`）平凡；反向即 `farkas_alternative_dotV`。

**诚实标注**：这里 `K` 是**给定的**闭凸锥；把 `K` 具体取成有限生成锥 `cone{∇gᵢ}` 时，
「有限生成锥本身闭」这一事实**未证**（见 `farkas_multiplier_criterion` 的说明）。
stmt:
theorem farkas_fin_conic {d : ℕ} (K : ConvexCone ℝ (Fin d → ℝ))
    (hne : (K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)).Nonempty) (hc : IsClosed (K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)))
    {b : Fin d → ℝ} :
    (∀ y : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ dotV x y) → 0 ≤ dotV b y) ↔ b ∈ K
proof: ⟨fun h => farkas_alternative_dotV K hne hc h, fun hb _ hy => hy b hb⟩

name: farkas_multiplier_criterion
doc:
**Farkas 乘子判据**：`HasNonnegCombo grad (-gradF)`（即 KKT 驻点方程
`∇f + ∑ λᵢ ∇gᵢ = 0`、`λ ≥ 0` 的可解性）**等价于**
「所有可行方向 `v`（`∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, v⟩ ≤ 0`）都满足 `⟨∇f, v⟩ ≥ 0`」
（即可行方向都不下降 `f`）。

- 前向（`⟹`）：纯代数（`dotV_sum_smul_left` + `Finset.sum_nonpos`）；
- 反向（`⟸`）：把 `v` 换成 `-v` 得 `-gradF` 在 `nonnegComboCone grad` 的对偶锥中，
  再调用 `farkas_alternative_dotV`。

**诚实标注（未证/降级）**：反向需要 `IsClosed (nonnegComboCone grad)`。该闭性在数学上
对有限生成锥成立，但 **mathlib 4.14 未提供有限生成锥闭性的引理**（无多面体锥 API），
故此处作为**显式假设** `hc` 保留，不谎称已证。
stmt:
theorem farkas_multiplier_criterion {m d : ℕ} (grad : Fin m → (Fin d → ℝ))
    (gradF : Fin d → ℝ) (hc : IsClosed (nonnegComboCone grad : Set (Fin d → ℝ))) :
    HasNonnegCombo grad (-gradF) ↔
      (∀ v : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, dotV (grad i) v ≤ 0) → 0 ≤ dotV gradF v)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨lam, hlam, hb⟩ v hv
    have hb_eq : (∑ i, lam i • grad i) = -gradF := by
      funext j
      rw [Finset.sum_apply]
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      exact (hb j).symm
    have h1 : dotV (-gradF) v ≤ 0 := by
      rw [← hb_eq, dotV_sum_smul_left]
      exact Finset.sum_nonpos fun i _ => mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hlam i) (hv i)
    have h2 := dotV_neg_left gradF v
    linarith
  · intro h
    refine farkas_alternative_dotV (nonnegComboCone grad) ⟨0, ?_⟩ hc ?_
    · exact ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => le_refl 0, fun j => by simp⟩
    · intro y hy
      have h1 : ∀ i, dotV (grad i) (-y) ≤ 0 := by
        intro i
        have hg := hy (grad i) (grad_mem_nonnegComboCone grad i)
        rw [dotV_neg_right]
        linarith
      have h2 := h (-y) h1
      rw [dotV_neg_right] at h2
      rw [dotV_neg_left]
      linarith

name: dotV_add_smul_strict
doc:
**MFCQ 扰动（约束部分的纯代数引理）**：若 `v` 是弱可行方向（`∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, v⟩ ≤ 0`），
`w` 是严格方向（`∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, w⟩ < 0`），则对任意 `t > 0`，`v + t w` 仍是**严格**方向
（`∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, v + t w⟩ < 0`）。
proof:
by
  intro i
  rw [dotV_add_right, dotV_smul_right]
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hv i) with hlt | heq
  · have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ht (hw i)
    linarith
  · rw [heq, zero_add]
    exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ht (hw i)

name: mfcq_perturb
doc:
**MFCQ 扰动（目标值取正的情形）**：设 `MFCQ grad`（`∃ w, ∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, w⟩ < 0`），
`v` 满足 `∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, v⟩ ≤ 0` 且 `0 < ⟨∇f, v⟩`。则存在 `v'` 使
`∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, v'⟩ < 0` 且 `0 < ⟨∇f, v'⟩`。

证明：`v' = v + t w`，`t > 0` 取足够小。约束部分对**任意** `t > 0` 自动成立
（`dotV_add_smul_strict`）；目标部分只需 `t · ⟨∇f, w⟩` 不太负：
若 `⟨∇f, w⟩ ≥ 0` 取 `t = 1`，否则取 `t = ⟨∇f, v⟩ / (2·(−⟨∇f, w⟩))`。
stmt:
theorem mfcq_perturb {m d : ℕ} (grad : Fin m → (Fin d → ℝ)) (gradF : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hw : ∃ w : Fin d → ℝ, ∀ i, dotV (grad i) w < 0) {v : Fin d → ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i, dotV (grad i) v ≤ 0) (hvd : 0 < dotV gradF v) :
    ∃ v' : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, dotV (grad i) v' < 0) ∧ 0 < dotV gradF v'
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hw
  by_cases hB : 0 ≤ dotV gradF w
  · refine ⟨v + (1 : ℝ) • w, dotV_add_smul_strict hv hw zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
    rw [dotV_add_right, dotV_smul_right, one_mul]
    linarith
  · push_neg at hB
    refine ⟨v + (dotV gradF v / (2 * (-(dotV gradF w)))) • w, dotV_add_smul_strict hv hw ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact div_pos hvd (by linarith)
    · rw [dotV_add_right, dotV_smul_right]
      have hne : (2 : ℝ) * (-(dotV gradF w)) ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have heq : (dotV gradF v / (2 * (-(dotV gradF w)))) * dotV gradF w
          = -(dotV gradF v / 2) := by
                                                                                  
                                                     
        have hb : dotV gradF w ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          rw [h0] at hB
          linarith
        field_simp
        ring
      linarith

name: mfcq_perturb_neg
doc:
**MFCQ 扰动（目标值取负的下降方向情形）**：设 `MFCQ grad`，`v` 满足
`∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, v⟩ ≤ 0` 且 `⟨∇f, v⟩ < 0`。则存在 `v'` 使
`∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, v'⟩ < 0` 且 `⟨∇f, v'⟩ < 0`（**严格可行下降方向**）。
证明结构与 `mfcq_perturb` 对偶（取 `t = −⟨∇f, v⟩ / (2·⟨∇f, w⟩)` 于 `⟨∇f, w⟩ > 0` 的情形）。
stmt:
theorem mfcq_perturb_neg {m d : ℕ} (grad : Fin m → (Fin d → ℝ)) (gradF : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hw : ∃ w : Fin d → ℝ, ∀ i, dotV (grad i) w < 0) {v : Fin d → ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i, dotV (grad i) v ≤ 0) (hvd : dotV gradF v < 0) :
    ∃ v' : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, dotV (grad i) v' < 0) ∧ dotV gradF v' < 0
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hw
  by_cases hB : dotV gradF w ≤ 0
  · refine ⟨v + (1 : ℝ) • w, dotV_add_smul_strict hv hw zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
    rw [dotV_add_right, dotV_smul_right, one_mul]
    linarith
  · push_neg at hB
    refine ⟨v + (-(dotV gradF v) / (2 * dotV gradF w)) • w,
      dotV_add_smul_strict hv hw ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
    · rw [dotV_add_right, dotV_smul_right]
      have hne : (2 : ℝ) * dotV gradF w ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have heq : (-(dotV gradF v) / (2 * dotV gradF w)) * dotV gradF w
          = -(dotV gradF v / 2) := by
        field_simp [hne]
        try ring
      linarith

name: mfcq_strict_separation
doc:
**MFCQ 严格分离（符号正确版）**：在 `MFCQ grad` 下，若**不存在**非负乘子
（`¬ HasNonnegCombo grad (-gradF)`），则存在**严格可行下降方向** `v`：
`∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, v⟩ < 0` 且 `⟨∇f, v⟩ < 0`。

证明：由 `farkas_multiplier_criterion` 的逆否得弱方向 `v`（`∀ i, ≤ 0`、`⟨∇f, v⟩ < 0`），
再用 `mfcq_perturb_neg` 升级为严格方向。

**诚实标注**：`hc`（`nonnegComboCone grad` 闭）是承继自乘子判据的**未证**假设，见文件头。
stmt:
theorem mfcq_strict_separation {m d : ℕ} (grad : Fin m → (Fin d → ℝ)) (gradF : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hc : IsClosed (nonnegComboCone grad : Set (Fin d → ℝ))) (hMFCQ : MFCQ grad)
    (hnc : ¬ HasNonnegCombo grad (-gradF)) :
    ∃ v : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, dotV (grad i) v < 0) ∧ dotV gradF v < 0
proof:
by
  have hnot : ¬ (∀ v : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, dotV (grad i) v ≤ 0) → 0 ≤ dotV gradF v) :=
    fun h => hnc ((farkas_multiplier_criterion grad gradF hc).mpr h)
  push_neg at hnot
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvd⟩ := hnot
  exact mfcq_perturb_neg grad gradF hMFCQ hv hvd

name: mfcq_strict_separation_literal_false
doc:
**机器验证反例（标注：任务书符号不一致）**：任务书要求的命题
「`MFCQ grad` 且 `¬ HasNonnegCombo grad (-gradF)` ⟹ `∃ v, (∀ i, ⟨∇gᵢ, v⟩ < 0) ∧ 0 < ⟨∇f, v⟩`」
在 `d = 1`、`∇g = 1`、`∇f = 1` 时**为假**：此时 `MFCQ` 成立（`w = -1`），
`¬ HasNonnegCombo grad (-gradF)` 也成立（`-1 = λ · 1` 无 `λ ≥ 0` 解），
但 `⟨∇g, v⟩ = v`、`⟨∇f, v⟩ = v`，故结论要求 `v < 0 ∧ 0 < v`，不可能。

因此 MFCQ 的正确结论是**下降方向**（`⟨∇f, v⟩ < 0`），见 `mfcq_strict_separation`。
stmt:
theorem mfcq_strict_separation_literal_false :
    ∃ (grad : Fin 1 → (Fin 1 → ℝ)) (gradF : Fin 1 → ℝ),
      MFCQ grad ∧ ¬ HasNonnegCombo grad (-gradF) ∧
        ¬ (∃ v : Fin 1 → ℝ, (∀ i, dotV (grad i) v < 0) ∧ 0 < dotV gradF v)
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun _ => fun _ => (1 : ℝ), fun _ => (1 : ℝ), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨fun _ => (-1 : ℝ), ?_⟩
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    simp [dotV, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  · rintro ⟨lam, hlam, hb⟩
    have h1 := hb 0
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply, Fin.sum_univ_one, mul_one] at h1
    have h0 := hlam 0
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvd⟩
    have h1 := hv 0
    simp [dotV, Fin.sum_univ_one] at h1 hvd
    linarith

end Lattice

name: le_fenchelConjugate
doc: sup 的上界性质：每个 i 的 x_i·y − f(x_i) 都不超过 f*(y)。
stmt:
lemma le_fenchelConjugate {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) : x i * y - f (x i) ≤ fenchelConjugate f x y
proof: Finset.le_sup' (fun i => x i * y - f (x i)) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: fenchel_inequality
stmt:
theorem fenchel_inequality {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (y : ℝ) (i : Fin n) : x i * y ≤ f (x i) + fenchelConjugate f x y
proof:
by
  have h := le_fenchelConjugate f x y i
  linarith

name: fenchel_biconjugate_le
doc:
f** ≤ f（Fenchel–Moreau 的弱方向，**恒成立**）：
对每个斜率 y 与每个支撑点 x_j，y·x_j − f*(y) ≤ f(x_j)；对 y 取 sup 即得。
stmt:
theorem fenchel_biconjugate_le {m n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] [Nonempty (Fin m)]
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (ys : Fin m → ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    fenchelBiconjugate f x ys j ≤ f (x j)
proof:
by
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro i _
  have h := le_fenchelConjugate f x (ys i) j
  rw [mul_comm (ys i) (x j)]
  linarith

name: fenchel_dual_lower_bound
doc:
f-散度的 Fenchel 对偶下界：
若有限支撑 x 包含所有 p_a/q_a（`hin`）、q 严格正，则对任意 g
  Σ_a p_a·g_a − Σ_a q_a·f*(g_a) ≤ D_f(q‖p) = Σ_a q_a·f(p_a/q_a)。
证明：逐项 Fenchel 不等式 (p_a/q_a)·g_a ≤ f(p_a/q_a) + f*(g_a)，
乘 q_a > 0 得 p_a·g_a ≤ q_a·f(p_a/q_a) + q_a·f*(g_a)，求和。
stmt:
theorem fenchel_dual_lower_bound {k n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hin : ∀ a, ∃ i, x i = p a / q a)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (g : Fin k → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, p a * g a) - ∑ a, q a * fenchelConjugate f x (g a)
      ≤ fDivergence f q p
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ a, p a * g a - q a * fenchelConjugate f x (g a)
      ≤ q a * f (p a / q a) := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hin a
    have h := le_fenchelConjugate f x (g a) i
    rw [hi] at h
    have h2 : (p a / q a) * g a ≤ f (p a / q a) + fenchelConjugate f x (g a) := by
      linarith
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (le_of_lt (hq a))
    have h3 : q a * ((p a / q a) * g a) = p a * g a := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_div_self (p a) (q a) (ne_of_gt (hq a))]
    have h4 : q a * (f (p a / q a) + fenchelConjugate f x (g a))
        = q a * f (p a / q a) + q a * fenchelConjugate f x (g a) := by ring
    rw [h3, h4] at hmul
    linarith
  calc (∑ a, p a * g a) - ∑ a, q a * fenchelConjugate f x (g a)
      = ∑ a, (p a * g a - q a * fenchelConjugate f x (g a)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ ≤ ∑ a, q a * f (p a / q a) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => hterm a)
    _ = fDivergence f q p := rfl

name: kl_dual_lower_bound
doc: KL 的对偶下界（f = t·log t 的推论）：由 `kl_as_fdiv` 把 D_f(q‖p) 换成 KL(p‖q)。
stmt:
theorem kl_dual_lower_bound {k n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hin : ∀ a, ∃ i, x i = p a / q a) (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a)
    (g : Fin k → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, p a * g a)
        - ∑ a, q a * fenchelConjugate (fun t => t * Real.log t) x (g a) ≤ kl p q
proof:
by
  have h := fenchel_dual_lower_bound (fun t => t * Real.log t) p q x hin hq g
  rwa [kl_as_fdiv p q hp hq] at h

name: mul_log_sub_le_exp
stmt:
lemma mul_log_sub_le_exp (t y : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    t * y - t * Real.log t ≤ Real.exp (y - 1)
proof:
by
  by_cases ht0 : t = 0
  · rw [ht0]
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) * y - 0 * Real.log 0 = 0 := by ring
    rw [hz]
    exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)
  · have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_le_of_ne ht (Ne.symm ht0)
    set E : ℝ := Real.exp (y - 1) with hE
    have hEpos : 0 < E := Real.exp_pos _
    set u : ℝ := t / E with hu
    have hupos : 0 < u := div_pos htpos hEpos
    have ht_eq : t = u * E := by
      rw [hu]; field_simp
    have hlogt : Real.log t = Real.log u + (y - 1) := by
      rw [ht_eq, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hupos) (ne_of_gt hEpos), hE, Real.log_exp]
    have hkey : t * y - t * Real.log t = u * E * (1 - Real.log u) := by
      rw [hlogt, ht_eq]; ring
    have hbound : 1 - Real.log u ≤ u⁻¹ := by
      have := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hupos
      linarith
    have hstep : u * E * (1 - Real.log u) ≤ u * E * u⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hupos) (le_of_lt hEpos))
    have hcancel : u * E * u⁻¹ = E := by
      field_simp
    rw [hkey]
    linarith [hstep, hcancel]

name: fenchelConjugate_mul_log_le_exp
doc: f = t·log t 的共轭上界：f*(y) ≤ e^{y−1}（逐点标量不等式 + sup 的最小上界性质）。
stmt:
lemma fenchelConjugate_mul_log_le_exp {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] (x : Fin n → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) :
    fenchelConjugate (fun t => t * Real.log t) x y ≤ Real.exp (y - 1)
proof:
by
  apply fenchelConjugate_le
  intro i
  exact mul_log_sub_le_exp (x i) y (hx i)

name: kl_dual_representation
doc:
KL 的对偶表示（取到版）：取 g_a = log(p_a/q_a) + 1，则对偶配对精确等于 KL(p‖q)。
    （f = t·log t，有限支撑 x ⊇ {p_a/q_a}。）
stmt:
theorem kl_dual_representation {k n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hin : ∀ a, ∃ i, x i = p a / q a) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) :
    kl p q
      = (∑ a, p a * (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1))
        - ∑ a, q a
            * fenchelConjugate (fun t => t * Real.log t) x (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1)
proof:
by
  have hval : ∀ a, fenchelConjugate (fun t => t * Real.log t) x (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1)
      = p a / q a := by
    intro a
    apply le_antisymm
    · have h := fenchelConjugate_mul_log_le_exp x (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1) hx
      rwa [show Real.log (p a / q a) + 1 - 1 = Real.log (p a / q a) by ring,
        Real.exp_log (div_pos (hp a) (hq a))] at h
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hin a
      have h := le_fenchelConjugate (fun t => t * Real.log t) x
        (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1) i
      rw [hi] at h
      have hkey : (p a / q a) * (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1)
          - (p a / q a) * Real.log (p a / q a) = p a / q a := by ring
      linarith
  have hsum_q : (∑ a, q a * (p a / q a)) = ∑ a, p a := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (hq a)]
  calc kl p q = ∑ a, p a * Real.log (p a / q a) := kl_as_sum_log_ratio p q hp hq
    _ = ∑ a, p a * (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1) - ∑ a, p a := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a _
          ring
    _ = ∑ a, p a * (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1) - ∑ a, q a * (p a / q a) := by
          rw [hsum_q]
    _ = (∑ a, p a * (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1))
        - ∑ a, q a
            * fenchelConjugate (fun t => t * Real.log t) x (Real.log (p a / q a) + 1) := by
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a _
          rw [hval a]

name: tv_dual_upper
doc: TV 变分表示的上界半边：任意 |g| ≤ 1 给出 Σ_a (p_a − q_a)·g_a ≤ TV(p,q)。
stmt:
theorem tv_dual_upper {k : ℕ} (p q g : Fin k → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a)
    (hg : ∀ a, |g a| ≤ 1) :
    ∑ a, (p a - q a) * g a ≤ tv p q
proof:
by
  rw [tv_eq_sum_abs p q hp]
  calc ∑ a, (p a - q a) * g a ≤ ∑ a, |p a - q a| := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro a _
        calc (p a - q a) * g a ≤ |(p a - q a) * g a| := le_abs_self _
          _ = |p a - q a| * |g a| := abs_mul _ _
          _ ≤ |p a - q a| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg a) (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = |p a - q a| := mul_one _
    _ = ∑ a, |q a - p a| := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        rw [abs_sub_comm]

name: tv_dual_attained
doc:
TV 变分表示的取到半边：g = sign(q − p)（即 q ≥ p 时取 −1、否则取 1，满足 |g| ≤ 1）
给出 Σ_a (p_a − q_a)·g_a = TV(p,q)。
stmt:
theorem tv_dual_attained {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) :
    ∑ a, (p a - q a) * (if q a ≥ p a then -1 else 1) = tv p q
proof:
by
  rw [tv_eq_sum_abs p q hp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases h : q a ≥ p a
  · have h1 : |q a - p a| = q a - p a := abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)
    rw [if_pos h, h1]
    ring
  · have h1 : |q a - p a| = p a - q a := by
      rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]
      ring
    rw [if_neg h, h1]
    ring

end Lattice

name: fenchelConjAllEReal_eq_iSup
doc: 把定义写成 `iSup` 形式，便于使用完备格引理（`sSup_range`）。
stmt:
lemma fenchelConjAllEReal_eq_iSup (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    fenchelConjAllEReal f y = ⨆ z : ℝ, ((z * y - f z : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
by
  rw [fenchelConjAllEReal, sSup_range]

name: le_fenchelConjAllEReal
doc:
`sSup` 的上界性质：每个 `z·y − f z` 都不超过 `f*(y)`。**无条件**——
这正是 `EReal` 值域的意义（旧版 `le_fenchelConjAll` 需要 `BddAbove`）。
stmt:
lemma le_fenchelConjAllEReal (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y z : ℝ) :
    ((z * y - f z : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ fenchelConjAllEReal f y
proof:
by
  rw [fenchelConjAllEReal_eq_iSup]
  exact le_iSup (fun z : ℝ => ((z * y - f z : ℝ) : EReal)) z

name: fenchelConjAllEReal_le
doc:
`sSup` 的最小上界性质：若每个 `z·y − f z ≤ C`，则 `f*(y) ≤ C`。**无条件**；
`C : EReal` 可取 `⊤`。
stmt:
lemma fenchelConjAllEReal_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (C : EReal)
    (h : ∀ z : ℝ, ((z * y - f z : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ C) :
    fenchelConjAllEReal f y ≤ C
proof:
by
  rw [fenchelConjAllEReal_eq_iSup]
  exact iSup_le h

name: fenchel_ineq_all_ereal
doc:
**Fenchel 不等式（`EReal` 版，无条件）**：`z·y ≤ f z + f*(y)`。
旧版 `RealFenchelMoreau.fenchel_ineq_all` 必须假设 `BddAbove`，本版不需要。
（`EReal` 版中右端可能为 `⊤`，命题仍有意义且为真。）
stmt:
lemma fenchel_ineq_all_ereal (f : ℝ → ℝ) (z y : ℝ) :
    ((z * y : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ ((f z : ℝ) : EReal) + fenchelConjAllEReal f y
proof:
by
  have h := le_fenchelConjAllEReal f y z
                                                                    
  rw [show ((z * y : ℝ) : EReal)
      = ((f z : ℝ) : EReal) + ((z * y - f z : ℝ) : EReal) from by
    rw [← EReal.coe_add]; ring_nf]
  exact add_le_add le_rfl h

name: fenchelConjAllEReal_le_of_bddAbove
doc: 集合在 `ℝ` 中有上界 ⟹ `f*(y) ≤ ↑M`（作为 `EReal`）。
stmt:
lemma fenchelConjAllEReal_le_of_bddAbove (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ z : ℝ, z * y - f z ≤ M) : fenchelConjAllEReal f y ≤ ((M : ℝ) : EReal)
proof: fenchelConjAllEReal_le f y _ fun z => EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (hM z)

name: fenchelConjAllEReal_eq_top_iff
doc:
**`⊤` 语义正确性（路线 A 的目标之一）**：`f*(y) = ⊤` **当且仅当**
`{z·y − f z}` 在 `ℝ` 中**无上界**。

这正是旧 `ℝ` 值版本丢掉的信息：旧版在该情形静默返回 junk 值 `0`，
使 `f*` 的凸性与演算律**必须**外加 `BddAbove` 才知道自己在说什么。
`EReal` 版把"无上界"**编码进值本身**，故假设可整体取消。
stmt:
theorem fenchelConjAllEReal_eq_top_iff (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    fenchelConjAllEReal f y = ⊤
      ↔ ¬ BddAbove (Set.range fun z : ℝ => (z * y - f z : ℝ))
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro htop ⟨M, hM⟩
    have hle := fenchelConjAllEReal_le_of_bddAbove f y M fun z => hM ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rw [htop] at hle
    exact EReal.coe_ne_top M (top_le_iff.mp hle)
  · intro hnb
    by_contra hne
    have hbot : fenchelConjAllEReal f y ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro hb
      have h0 := le_fenchelConjAllEReal f y 0
      rw [hb] at h0
      exact not_le_of_gt (EReal.bot_lt_coe (0 * y - f 0)) h0
    have hcoe : (((fenchelConjAllEReal f y).toReal : ℝ) : EReal) = fenchelConjAllEReal f y :=
      EReal.coe_toReal hne hbot
    refine hnb ⟨(fenchelConjAllEReal f y).toReal, fun v hv => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hv
    have hz := le_fenchelConjAllEReal f y z
    rw [← hcoe] at hz
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hz

name: fenchelConjAllEReal_convex
doc:
**`f*` 的凸性（`EReal` 版，无 `BddAbove`）** —— 本文件核心目标之一：
`f*(a·y₁ + b·y₂) ≤ a·f*(y₁) + b·f*(y₂)`，`a, b ≥ 0`、`a + b = 1`。

对照 `RealConjugateDuality.fenchelConjAll_convex`：旧版带**三个** `BddAbove`
假设（`_h12`、`h1`、`h2`），本版**一个都不要**。

证明：对每个 `z`，由 `a + b = 1` 有
`z·(a·y₁ + b·y₂) − f z = a·(z·y₁ − f z) + b·(z·y₂ − f z)`，
右端两分量分别 ≤ `a·f*(y₁)`、`b·f*(y₂)`，故 `a·f*(y₁) + b·f*(y₂)` 是 `sSup` 的上界，
`iSup_le` 收尾——**上界取 `EReal`，可以就是 `⊤`**，这正是取消假设的关键。
stmt:
theorem fenchelConjAllEReal_convex (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y₁ y₂ a b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    fenchelConjAllEReal f (a * y₁ + b * y₂)
      ≤ ((a : ℝ) : EReal) * fenchelConjAllEReal f y₁
        + ((b : ℝ) : EReal) * fenchelConjAllEReal f y₂
proof:
by
  apply fenchelConjAllEReal_le
  intro z
  have e1 := le_fenchelConjAllEReal f y₁ z
  have e2 := le_fenchelConjAllEReal f y₂ z
  have hsum : (a + b) * f z = f z := by rw [hab, one_mul]
  have key : z * (a * y₁ + b * y₂) - f z
      = a * (z * y₁ - f z) + b * (z * y₂ - f z) := by linarith [hsum]
  have hcoe : ((z * (a * y₁ + b * y₂) - f z : ℝ) : EReal)
      = ((a * (z * y₁ - f z) : ℝ) : EReal) + ((b * (z * y₂ - f z) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [key, EReal.coe_add]
  rw [hcoe]
  have m1 : ((a * (z * y₁ - f z) : ℝ) : EReal)
      ≤ ((a : ℝ) : EReal) * fenchelConjAllEReal f y₁ := by
    rw [EReal.coe_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr ha)
  have m2 : ((b * (z * y₂ - f z) : ℝ) : EReal)
      ≤ ((b : ℝ) : EReal) * fenchelConjAllEReal f y₂ := by
    rw [EReal.coe_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hb)
  exact add_le_add m1 m2

name: fenchelConjAllEReal_shift
doc:
**平移规则（`EReal` 版，无条件）**：`(f + ⟨a,·⟩)*(y) = f*(y − a)`。
只需**集合层面的逐点恒等式** `z·y − (f z + a·z) = z·(y − a) − f z`，
两侧 `sSup` 集合完全相同。旧版此处**本就没有** `BddAbove`，本版保持一致。
stmt:
theorem fenchelConjAllEReal_shift (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a y : ℝ) :
    fenchelConjAllEReal (fun z => f z + a * z) y = fenchelConjAllEReal f (y - a)
proof:
by
  have hset : (Set.range fun z : ℝ => ((z * y - (f z + a * z) : ℝ) : EReal))
      = Set.range fun z : ℝ => ((z * (y - a) - f z : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    apply congrArg Set.range
    funext z
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [fenchelConjAllEReal, hset, fenchelConjAllEReal]

name: fenchelConjAllEReal_add_le_split
doc:
**加法规则（`EReal` 版，下卷积拆分形式，无 `BddAbove`）**：
对**任意**分解 `y = y₁ + y₂`，
`(f+g)*(y₁ + y₂) ≤ f*(y₁) + g*(y₂)`。
真恒等式是 `z·(y₁+y₂) − (f z + g z) = (z·y₁ − f z) + (z·y₂ − g z)`。
旧版 `RealConjugateDuality.fenchelConjAll_add_le_split` 带**三个** `BddAbove`，
`EReal` 版一个都不要。
stmt:
theorem fenchelConjAllEReal_add_le_split (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (y₁ y₂ : ℝ) :
    fenchelConjAllEReal (fun z => f z + g z) (y₁ + y₂)
      ≤ fenchelConjAllEReal f y₁ + fenchelConjAllEReal g y₂
proof:
by
  apply fenchelConjAllEReal_le
  intro z
  have e1 := le_fenchelConjAllEReal f y₁ z
  have e2 := le_fenchelConjAllEReal g y₂ z
  have key : z * (y₁ + y₂) - (f z + g z) = (z * y₁ - f z) + (z * y₂ - g z) := by ring
  have hcoe : ((z * (y₁ + y₂) - (f z + g z) : ℝ) : EReal)
      = ((z * y₁ - f z : ℝ) : EReal) + ((z * y₂ - g z : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [key, EReal.coe_add]
  rw [hcoe]
  exact add_le_add e1 e2

name: fenchelConjAllEReal_scaling_le
doc:
**缩放规则（`EReal` 版，**诚实降级为 `≤`**，无 `BddAbove`）**：
`λ > 0` ⟹ `(λ·f)*(y) ≤ λ·f*(y/λ)`。

逐点恒等式 `↑(z·y − λ·f z) = ↑λ · ↑(z·(y/λ) − f z)`（`EReal.coe_mul`）给出
`(λf)*(y) = ⨆ z, ↑λ · g z`，而 `↑λ · ⨆ z, g z` 是它的上界
（`mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left` + `EReal.instPosMulMono`），故 `≤` 成立。

**诚实降级（未证等号）**：等号方向需要把 `↑λ` 提出 `iSup`，即
`↑λ * ⨆ g = ⨆ (↑λ * g)`。本版 mathlib 的 `EReal` **无 `PosMulReflectLE`**
（不能消去 `↑λ`）且**无 `ContinuousMul`**（不能用
`Monotone.map_iSup_of_continuousAt`），故**未证**。**标注为后续工作**。
下游演算只用到 Fenchel 不等式方向（`≤`），故本文件其余结论不受影响。
旧版 `RealConjugateDuality.fenchelConjAll_scaling` 是等号，但需 `BddAbove`。
stmt:
theorem fenchelConjAllEReal_scaling_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    fenchelConjAllEReal (fun z => lam * f z) y
      ≤ ((lam : ℝ) : EReal) * fenchelConjAllEReal f (y / lam)
proof:
by

name: subgradient_iff_fenchelConjAllEReal_eq
doc:
**次梯度 ⟺ 共轭等式（`EReal` 版，无 `BddAbove`）**：
`g ∈ ∂f(x) ⟺ f*(g) = ↑(g·x − f x)`。

两个方向都**不需要凸性，也不需要 `BddAbove`**——这正是 `EReal` 值域的收益。
旧版 `RealFenchelMoreau.subgradient_iff_fenchelConj_eq` 必须假设
`BddAbove {z·g − f z}` 才能陈述（否则 `ℝ` 值 `sSup` 可为 junk 值 `0`
而使 iff 为假）；`EReal` 版把该前提吸收进 `⊤` 语义。
stmt:
theorem subgradient_iff_fenchelConjAllEReal_eq (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x g : ℝ) :
    Subgradient f x g
      ↔ fenchelConjAllEReal f g = ((g * x - f x : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply fenchelConjAllEReal_le
      intro z
      have h := hg z
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    · have h := le_fenchelConjAllEReal f g x
      rwa [show x * g - f x = g * x - f x from by ring] at h
  · intro heq z
    have h := le_fenchelConjAllEReal f g z
    rw [heq] at h
    have h' := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp h
    linarith

name: fenchelConjAllEReal_lowerSemicontinuous
doc:
**`f*` 的下半连续性（`EReal` 版，无条件）** —— 旧 `ℝ` 版**未做**，
在 `EReal` 下由完备格结构**免费**得到：

`f*(y) = ⨆_z ↑(z·y − f z)` 是一族**连续函数**的逐点上确界，
而 `lowerSemicontinuous_iSup` 断言（`δ` 为 `CompleteLinearOrder` 时）
下半连续函数的 `iSup` 仍下半连续。`EReal` 正是完备线性序。

**注意**：`f*` 的 LSC **不需要 `f` 的任何假设**——凸性、闭性、有界性都不要，
也不需要 `BddAbove`。这与"共轭是仿射函数族的 sup"这一几何直觉一致。
`ℝ` 值域下同一定理**不成立**（`ℝ` 无 `⊤`，`iSup` 不被上半连续保持），
故这是 `EReal` 值域的**额外收益**。
stmt:
theorem fenchelConjAllEReal_lowerSemicontinuous (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    LowerSemicontinuous fun y : ℝ => fenchelConjAllEReal f y
proof:
by
  have h : (fun y : ℝ => fenchelConjAllEReal f y)
      = fun y : ℝ => ⨆ z : ℝ, ((z * y - f z : ℝ) : EReal) :=
    funext fun y => fenchelConjAllEReal_eq_iSup f y
  rw [h]
  exact lowerSemicontinuous_iSup fun z =>
    (continuous_fenchelConjAllEReal_term f z).lowerSemicontinuous

doc:

    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hb

    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hb

      exact hM ⟨z, by ring⟩⟩

      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hb

doc:
**真下界的 ε-逼近（上确界的逼近性质）**：
若 `{w*y − f w}` 有上界，则对任意 `ε > 0` 存在 `w₀` 使
`f* y − ε ≤ w₀*y − f w₀`。

证明：若不然，`w₀*y − f w₀ < f* y − ε` 对所有 `w₀` 成立，即

theorem fenchelConjAll_sub_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)

    ∃ w₀ : ℝ, fenchelConjAll f y - ε ≤ w₀ * y - f w₀
proof:
by

  push_neg at hcon
                   
  have hub : ∀ v ∈ {v : ℝ | ∃ w, v = w * y - f w}, v ≤ fenchelConjAll f y - ε := by
    rintro v ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact le_of_lt (hcon w)
                   
  have hmin : fenchelConjAll f y ≤ fenchelConjAll f y - ε :=
    csSup_le (fenchelConjAll_nonempty f y) hub
  linarith

doc:

doc:

name: const_zero_conj_unbounded
doc:
**在 junk 点上的「条件确实会失效」（诚实标注的具体化）**：
取 `f := fun _ => 0`，则 `{w*y − 0} = Set.range (fun w => w*y)` 在 `y ≠ 0` 时**无上界**，
故 `fenchelConjAll f y = 0`（junk），而真正的共轭应为 `+∞`。

本定理给出**可机器验证的部分**：`y ≠ 0` 时集合无上界（`¬ BddAbove`），
故 `fenchelConjAll_lsc` 的 `hbd` 假设在该点上**不可满足**——
这说明 `BddAbove` 不是装饰性假设，而是定理成立所必需的。
stmt:
theorem const_zero_conj_unbounded (y : ℝ) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    ¬ BddAbove {v : ℝ | ∃ w, v = w * y - (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) w}
proof:
by
  intro hbd
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd
                                              
                                                         
                                            
                                                        
  have key : ∀ t : ℝ, C < t → t ∈ {v : ℝ | ∃ w, v = w * y - (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) w} := by
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨t / y, by
      have h : (t / y : ℝ) * y = t := by field_simp
      rw [h, sub_zero]⟩
                                          
  exact absurd (hC (key (C + 1) (by linarith))) (by linarith)

name: csSup_sub_le_of_bddAbove
doc:
**B3 的集合论形式（去掉 `f` 的依赖）**：对任意实集 `S`，
`S` 有上界时 `sSup` 的「下半连续模」由 `S` 的逼近元给出。

这是 `fenchelConjAll_lsc` 去掉共轭包装后的纯序事实：
`BddAbove S`、`Nonempty S` 时，对任意 `ε > 0` 存在 `s ∈ S` 使 `sSup S − ε ≤ s`。
本文件把它单列，因为**这是 B3 全部内容的序论内核**（共轭只是把 `S` 取成
`{w*y − f w}`），也说明为何 `BddAbove` 恰好是必需的假设。
stmt:
theorem csSup_sub_le_of_bddAbove {S : Set ℝ} (hne : S.Nonempty) (_hbd : BddAbove S) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s ∈ S, sSup S - ε ≤ s
proof:
by
  intro ε hε
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hub : ∀ v ∈ S, v ≤ sSup S - ε := fun v hv => le_of_lt (hcon v hv)
  have hmin : sSup S ≤ sSup S - ε := csSup_le hne hub
  linarith

name: fenchelConjAll_sublevel_open
doc:
**共轭的闭性（`epigraph` 形式，条件版）**：`f*` 在 `y` 处 lsc 等价于
「所有下水平集 `{y' | f* y' ≤ c}` 是闭集」。

本文件给出**局部化**版本：在 `hbd` 下，对任意 `c : ℝ`，
下水平集在 `y` 处的补是开集（即 `{y' | c < f* y'}` 是开集）。
完整的一般闭性（不局部化到单个 `y`）需要在整个定义域上逐点携带 `BddAbove`，
本文件**未做**该全局版本（标注）。
stmt:
theorem fenchelConjAll_sublevel_open (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y c : ℝ)
    (hbd : BddAbove {v : ℝ | ∃ w, v = w * y - f w})
    (hloc : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 y, BddAbove {v : ℝ | ∃ w, v = w * y' - f w})
    (hc : c < fenchelConjAll f y) :
    {y' : ℝ | c < fenchelConjAll f y'} ∈ 𝓝 y
proof:
by
                                                                         
                                                                                
                                                                                    
                                                           
                                                                      
  have hε : 0 < (fenchelConjAll f y - c) / 2 := by linarith
  have h0 := fenchelConjAll_lsc_eventually f y hbd hloc ((fenchelConjAll f y - c) / 2) hε
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 y, (fenchelConjAll f y + c) / 2 ≤ fenchelConjAll f y' := by
    refine h0.mono fun y' hy' => ?_
    have hsub : fenchelConjAll f y - (fenchelConjAll f y - c) / 2
        = (fenchelConjAll f y + c) / 2 := by ring
    calc (fenchelConjAll f y + c) / 2
        = fenchelConjAll f y - (fenchelConjAll f y - c) / 2 := hsub.symm
      _ ≤ fenchelConjAll f y' := hy'
                                                                               
                                                        
  refine mem_of_superset hev ?_
  intro y' hy'
                                                                                 
                                                                                
                                                                         
  have hy'' : (fenchelConjAll f y + c) / 2 ≤ fenchelConjAll f y' := hy'
  show c < fenchelConjAll f y'
  have hmid : c < (fenchelConjAll f y + c) / 2 := by linarith
  lina

name: fenchel_ineq_all
doc: Fenchel 不等式（一维全空间）：z·y ≤ f z + f*(y)（需 f*(y) 有限）。
stmt:
lemma fenchel_ineq_all (f : ℝ → ℝ) (z y : ℝ)
    (hb : BddAbove {v : ℝ | ∃ w : ℝ, v = w * y - f w}) :
    z * y ≤ f z + fenchelConjAll f y
proof:
by
  have h := le_fenchelConjAll f y z hb
  linarith

name: fenchelConjAll_subgradient
doc:
**核心**：若 g ∈ ∂f(x)（即 ∀ z, f z ≥ f x + g·(z − x)），则
f*(g) = g·x − f(x)：上确界在 z = x 处被取到。
（这里只需次梯度不等式，`hf` 未用到；保留它以对齐任务接口。）
stmt:
theorem fenchelConjAll_subgradient (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x g : ℝ)
    (_hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) (hg : Subgradient f x g) :
    fenchelConjAll f g = g * x - f x
proof:
by
  have hb : BddAbove {v : ℝ | ∃ z : ℝ, v = z * g - f z} := by
    refine ⟨g * x - f x, ?_⟩
    rintro v ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have h := hg z
    linarith
  apply le_antisymm
  ·                                                                    
                                                                 
    apply fenchelConjAll_le f g (g * x - f x) ⟨x * g - f x, x, by ring⟩
    intro z
    have h := hg z
    linarith
  · simpa [mul_comm] using le_fenchelConjAll f g x hb

name: fenchel_biconj_le_self
doc:
f** ≤ f（Fenchel–Moreau 的弱半边，**不需要凸性**）：
集合 {y·x − f*(y)} 的每个元素 ≤ f(x)，由 `le_fenchelConjAll` 在 z := x 处给出。
**诚实标注**：需显式假设该 sSup 集合非空——否则 `sSup` 返回 junk 值 0，
结论可能为假。凸性可保证非空（见 `fenchel_biconj_eq_self`），此处不假设凸性。
stmt:
theorem fenchel_biconj_le_self (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ)
    (hne : ({v : ℝ | ∃ y : ℝ,
      BddAbove {w : ℝ | ∃ z : ℝ, w = z * y - f z} ∧
        v = y * x - fenchelConjAll f y}).Nonempty) :
    fenchelBiconjAll f x ≤ f x
proof:
by
  apply csSup_le hne
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨y, hyb, rfl⟩ := hv
  have h := le_fenchelConjAll f y x hyb
  linarith

name: fenchel_biconj_eq_self
doc:
**Fenchel–Moreau 等号方向（一维）**：凸 f : ℝ → ℝ 的二次共轭等于自身，f**(x) = f(x)。

证明：
  · ≥ 方向（`f x ≤ f** x`）：取次梯度 g ∈ ∂f(x)（`subgradient_exists_of_convex`），
    其对应的元素 `g·x − f*(g) = g·x − (g·x − f x) = f x` 落在 f** 的 sSup 集合中，
    `le_csSup` 给出；
  · ≤ 方向（`f** x ≤ f x`）：集合非空（同上元素），且每个元素
    `y·x − f*(y) ≤ f x`，由 `le_fenchelConjAll` 在 z := x 处给出，`csSup_le` 收尾。

一维下**不需要** f 的闭性/下半连续性：定义域 = ℝ 保证处处有限、处处有次梯度。
stmt:
theorem fenchel_biconj_eq_self (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) (x : ℝ) :
    fenchelBiconjAll f x = f x
proof:
by
  let T : Set ℝ := {v : ℝ | ∃ y : ℝ,
    BddAbove {w : ℝ | ∃ z : ℝ, w = z * y - f z} ∧ v = y * x - fenchelConjAll f y}
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := subgradient_exists_of_convex f x hf
  have hgBdd : BddAbove {w : ℝ | ∃ z : ℝ, w = z * g - f z} := by
    refine ⟨g * x - f x, ?_⟩
    rintro v ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have h := hg z
    linarith
  have hmem : f x ∈ T := by
    refine ⟨g, hgBdd, ?_⟩
    rw [fenchelConjAll_subgradient f x g hf hg]
    ring
  have hbdd : BddAbove T := by
    refine ⟨f x, ?_⟩
    rintro v ⟨y, hyb, rfl⟩
    have h := le_fenchelConjAll f y x hyb
    linarith
  apply le_antisymm
  · show sSup T ≤ f x
    apply csSup_le ⟨f x, hmem⟩
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨y, hyb, rfl⟩ := hv
    have h := le_fenchelConjAll f y x hyb
    linarith
  · show f x ≤ sSup T
    exact le_csSup hbdd hmem

name: finite_support_le_all
doc:
**桥接** `RealFenchel` 的有限支撑共轭与全空间共轭：
`fenchelConjugate f xs y ≤ fenchelConjAll f y`
（有限支撑的 sup 不超过全空间的 sup；需 f*(y) 有限）。
`RealFenchel.fenchel_biconjugate_le` 是有限支撑的弱方向 f** ≤ f，
本文件的 `fenchel_biconj_eq_self` 是一维全空间的等号方向，二者互补。
stmt:
theorem finite_support_le_all (f : ℝ → ℝ) {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)]
    (xs : Fin n → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (hb : BddAbove {v : ℝ | ∃ z : ℝ, v = z * y - f z}) :
    fenchelConjugate f xs y ≤ fenchelConjAll f y
proof:
by
  apply fenchelConjugate_le
  intro i
  exact le_fenchelConjAll f y (xs i) hb

end Lattice

name: deriv_aug_x
stmt:
lemma deriv_aug_x (a b lam x : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun y => (a * y - b) ^ 2 + lam * (a * y - b)) x = 2 * a * (a * x - b) + lam * a
proof:
by
                                                     
  have h₁ : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (a * y - b) ^ 2) (2 * a * (a * x - b)) x := by
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a * y - b) a x := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul a).sub (hasDerivAt_const x b)
    have hpow : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (a * y - b) ^ 2) (2 * (a * x - b) * a) x := by
      simpa using hlin.pow 2
    simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hpow
                                 
  have h₂ : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => lam * (a * y - b)) (lam * a) x := by
    have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a * y - b) a x := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul a).sub (hasDerivAt_const x b)
    simpa using hinner.const_mul lam
                      
  have hadd : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (a * y - b) ^ 2 + lam * (a * y - b))
      ((2 * a * (a * x - b)) + lam * a) x := h₁.add h₂
  exact hadd.deriv

name: deriv_aug_lam
stmt:
lemma deriv_aug_lam (a b x : ℝ) (pt : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => (a * x - b) ^ 2 + t * (a * x - b)) pt = a * x - b
proof:
by
                                         
  have hconst : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (a * x - b) ^ 2) 0 pt := hasDerivAt_const pt _
  have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * (a * x - b)) (a * x - b) pt := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id pt).mul_const (a * x - b)
  have hadd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (a * x - b) ^ 2 + t * (a * x - b))
      (0 + (a * x - b)) pt := hconst.add hlin
  simpa using hadd.deriv

name: P4_augmented_stationarity
stmt:
theorem P4_augmented_stationarity (a b x lam : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (deriv (fun y => (a * y - b) ^ 2 + lam * (a * y - b)) x = 0 ∧
     deriv (fun t => (a * x - b) ^ 2 + t * (a * x - b)) lam = 0) ↔
    a * x = b ∧ lam = 0
proof:
by
  rw [deriv_aug_x a b lam x, deriv_aug_lam a b x lam]
  constructor
  · intro h
                      
    have hsat : a * x - b = 0 := h.2
    have hx : a * x = b := by linarith
                                                
    have hlam : lam = 0 := by
      have hfirst : 2 * a * (a * x - b) + lam * a = 0 := h.1
      have hzero : lam * a = 0 := by
        rw [hsat] at hfirst
        simpa using hfirst
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_right ha
    exact ⟨hx, hlam⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hx, hlam⟩
    constructor
    · rw [hx, hlam]
      ring
    · rw [hx]
      ring

name: P4_multiplier_encodes_violation
stmt:
theorem P4_multiplier_encodes_violation (a b x lam : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : deriv (fun y => (a * y - b) ^ 2 + lam * (a * y - b)) x = 0) :
    lam = -2 * (a * x - b)
proof:
by
  rw [deriv_aug_x a b lam x] at h
                                                                        
  have hmain : lam * a = -2 * a * (a * x - b) := by
    calc
      lam * a = -(2 * a * (a * x - b)) := by linarith
      _ = -2 * a * (a * x - b) := by ring
  calc
    lam = (lam * a) / a := by rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ lam ha]
    _ = (-2 * a * (a * x - b)) / a := by rw [hmain]
    _ = -2 * (a * x - b) := by
                                                     
      rw [show -2 * a * (a * x - b) = (-2 * (a * x - b)) * a by ring]
      rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ (-2 * (a * x - b)) ha]

end Lattice

name: convex_multImprovingSet
doc:
**多约束改进集是凸的**：`f`、各 `gᵢ` 凸 ⟹ `A` 凸。
取两见证点凸组合作新见证（`x = a x₁ + b x₂`），逐分量用凸性与线性性。
proof:
by
  rw [convex_iff_forall_pos]
  rintro ⟨u₁, v₁⟩ ⟨x₁, hg₁, hf₁⟩ ⟨u₂, v₂⟩ ⟨x₂, hg₂, hf₂⟩ aa bb ha hb hab
  refine ⟨aa * x₁ + bb * x₂, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have h := (hg i).2 (Set.mem_univ x₁) (Set.mem_univ x₂) ha.le hb.le hab
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
    have h1 : aa * g i x₁ ≤ aa * u₁ i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg₁ i) ha.le
    have h2 : bb * g i x₂ ≤ bb * u₂ i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg₂ i) hb.le
    show g i (aa * x₁ + bb * x₂) ≤ (aa • u₁ + bb • u₂) i
    rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    linarith
  · have h := hf.2 (Set.mem_univ x₁) (Set.mem_univ x₂) ha.le hb.le hab
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
    have h1 : aa * f x₁ ≤ aa * v₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf₁ ha.le
    have h2 : bb * f x₂ ≤ bb * v₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf₂ hb.le
    show f (aa * x₁ + bb * x₂) ≤ aa • v₁ + bb • v₂
    rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    linarith

name: interior_multImprovingSet_nonempty
doc:
**多约束改进集有内点**：以 `x` 为见证，`(g x + 1, f x + 1)` 的半径为 1 的
球整个落在 `A` 内（用乘积度量的坐标投影 `dist_le_pi_dist`）。
stmt:
theorem interior_multImprovingSet_nonempty {m : ℕ} (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin m → ℝ → ℝ)
    (x : ℝ) : (interior (multImprovingSet f g)).Nonempty
proof:
by
  refine ⟨(fun i => g i x + 1, f x + 1), ?_⟩
  have hsub : Metric.ball ((fun i => g i x + 1, f x + 1) : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) 1
      ⊆ multImprovingSet f g := by
    rintro ⟨u, v⟩ hq
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq] at hq
    have h1 : dist u (fun i => g i x + 1) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hq
    have h2 : |v - (f x + 1)| < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hq
    rw [abs_lt] at h2
    refine ⟨x, fun i => ?_, by linarith [h2.1, h2.2]⟩
    have hi : |u i - (g i x + 1)| ≤ dist u (fun i => g i x + 1) := by
      have h := dist_le_pi_dist u (fun i => g i x + 1) i
      rwa [Real.dist_eq] at h
    have hi' : |u i - (g i x + 1)| < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hi h1
    rw [abs_lt] at hi'
    show g i x ≤ (u, v).1 i
    simp only [Prod.fst]
    linarith [hi'.1, hi'.2]
  exact interior_maximal hsub Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos)

name: not_mem_interior_multImprovingSet
doc:
**最优值点不是改进集的内点**：`(0, f x̄)` 若为内点，则存在 `ε > 0` 使
`(0, f x̄ − ε/2) ∈ A`，即存在可行点 `y`（`∀i, gᵢ y ≤ 0`）满足 `f y < f x̄`，
与最优性矛盾。
stmt:
theorem not_mem_interior_multImprovingSet {m : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {g : Fin m → ℝ → ℝ}
    {xbar : ℝ} (hfeas : ∀ i, g i xbar ≤ 0)
    (hopt : ∀ y, (∀ i, g i y ≤ 0) → f xbar ≤ f y) :
    ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), f xbar) ∉ interior (multImprovingSet f g)
proof:
by
  intro hcon
  rcases Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hcon) with ⟨eps, heps, hball⟩
  have hdist : dist (((0 : Fin m → ℝ), f xbar - eps / 2)) (((0 : Fin m → ℝ), f xbar)) < eps := by
    rw [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
    have hzero : dist (0 : Fin m → ℝ) 0 = 0 := dist_self _
    have hval : |f xbar - eps / 2 - f xbar| = eps / 2 := by
      rw [show f xbar - eps / 2 - f xbar = -(eps / 2) by ring, abs_neg,
        abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < eps / 2)]
    rw [hzero, hval, max_eq_right (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ eps / 2)]
    linarith
  have hmem : ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), f xbar - eps / 2) ∈ multImprovingSet f g :=
    interior_subset (hball hdist)
  obtain ⟨y, hgy, hfy⟩ := hmem
  have h := hopt y hgy
  linarith

name: contLinMap_prod_coords
doc:
**乘积空间上连续线性泛函的坐标表示**：任何
`φ : ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ` 都可写成
`φ(u, v) = ∑ i, uᵢ · aᵢ + v · b`，其中 `aᵢ = φ(δᵢ, 0)`、`b = φ(0, 1)`
（`δᵢ = Pi.single i 1` 是标准基向量）。

证明：`u = ∑ i, uᵢ • δᵢ`（逐坐标展开），故 `φ(u, 0) = ∑ i, uᵢ · aᵢ`
（`map_sum` + `map_smul`）；`φ(0, v) = v · b`；再用 `map_add` 拆分 `(u,v) = (u,0) + (0,v)`。
stmt:
theorem contLinMap_prod_coords {m : ℕ} (phi : ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∃ (a : Fin m → ℝ) (b : ℝ), ∀ (u : Fin m → ℝ) (v : ℝ),
      phi (u, v) = (∑ i, u i * a i) + v * b
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun i => phi (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ), 0), phi (0, 1), ?_⟩
  intro u v
  have h1 : phi (u, (0 : ℝ)) = ∑ i, u i * phi (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ), 0) := by
    have hdecomp : u = ∑ i, u i • (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ) := by
      funext j
      rw [Finset.sum_apply]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · simp
      · intro i _ hij
        have hz : (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ) j = 0 := by
          simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)]
        rw [Pi.smul_apply, hz, smul_zero]
      · intro hj
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj
    have hpu : (u, (0 : ℝ)) = ∑ i, u i • ((Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := by
      have hfst : (u, (0 : ℝ)).1
          = (∑ i, u i • ((Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ), (0 : ℝ))).1 := by
        show u = (∑ i, u i • ((Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ), (0 : ℝ))).1
        rw [show (∑ i, u i • ((Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ), (0 : ℝ))).1
            = ∑ i, u i • (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ) from Prod.fst_sum]
        exact hdecomp
      have hsnd : (u, (0 : ℝ)).2
          = (∑ i, u i • ((Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ), (0 : ℝ))).2 := by
        rw [show (∑ i, u i • ((Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ), (0 : ℝ))).2
            = ∑ i, (u i • ((Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ), (0 : ℝ))).2
            from Prod.snd_sum]
        simp
      exact Prod.ext hfst hsnd
    rw [hpu, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro i _
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have h2 : phi ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), v) = v * p

name: sum_pi_single_mul
doc: 辅助：`∑ j, (Pi.single i T) j * a j = T * a i`（单点求和）。
stmt:
lemma sum_pi_single_mul {m : ℕ} (T : ℝ) (a : Fin m → ℝ) (i : Fin m) :
    (∑ j, (Pi.single i T : Fin m → ℝ) j * a j) = T * a i
proof:
by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hij
    rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hij, zero_mul]
  · intro hi
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi

name: mult_slater_multiplier_exists
doc:
**多变量-多约束 Slater 乘子存在（核心）**：`f`、各 `gᵢ` 凸、`x̄` 可行（`∀i, gᵢ x̄ ≤ 0`）
且最优、Slater（`∃ x₀, ∀ i, gᵢ x₀ < 0`）⟹ 存在乘子 `λ : Fin m → ℝ`，`λᵢ ≥ 0` 且
`∀ x, f x̄ ≤ f x + ∑ i, λᵢ · gᵢ x`。

证明路线：分离（`supporting_functional_of_not_mem_interior`）→ 坐标表示
`φ(u,v) = ∑ uᵢ aᵢ + v b` → `b(f x − f x̄) + ∑ aᵢ gᵢ x ≥ 0` → 逐坐标 `aᵢ ≥ 0`（令
`u = g x̄ + T·δᵢ`，`T → ∞`）与 `b ≥ 0`（令 `v = f x̄ + T`）→ `b ≠ 0`
（否则 `b = 0` 与 Slater 迫使所有 `aᵢ = 0`，即 `φ = 0`，与 `φ ≠ 0` 矛盾）
→ `λᵢ = aᵢ / b`。
stmt:
theorem mult_slater_multiplier_exists {m : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {g : Fin m → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) (hg : ∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (g i))
    {xbar : ℝ} (hfeas : ∀ i, g i xbar ≤ 0)
    (hopt : ∀ y, (∀ i, g i y ≤ 0) → f xbar ≤ f y)
    (hslater : ∃ x₀, ∀ i, g i x₀ < 0) :
    ∃ lam : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) ∧
      ∀ x, f xbar ≤ f x + ∑ i, lam i * g i x
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨phi, hphi_ne, -, hphi_sup⟩ :=
    supporting_functional_of_not_mem_interior (convex_multImprovingSet hf hg)
      (interior_multImprovingSet_nonempty f g xbar)
      (not_mem_interior_multImprovingSet hfeas hopt)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hcoord⟩ := contLinMap_prod_coords phi
                                        
  have hkey : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ b * (f x - f xbar) + ∑ i, a i * g i x := by
    intro x
    have hmem : (fun i => g i x, f x) ∈ multImprovingSet f g :=
      ⟨x, fun i => le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
    have h := hphi_sup (fun i => g i x, f x) hmem
    rw [hcoord, hcoord] at h
    have hzero : (∑ i, (0 : Fin m → ℝ) i * a i) = 0 := by simp
    rw [hzero, zero_add] at h
    have hsum_eq : (∑ i, g i x * a i) = ∑ i, a i * g i x :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    rw [hsum_eq] at h
    linarith
           
  have haa : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i := by
    intro i
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    set S : ℝ := ∑ j, g j xbar * a j with hS
    set T : ℝ := (|S| + 1) / (-a i) with hT
    have hai : a i ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hneg
    have hTpos : 0 < T := by
      rw [hT]
      exact div_pos (by positivity) (by linarith)
    have hmemT : (fun j => g j xbar + (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ) j * T, f xbar)
        ∈ multImprovingSet f g := by
      refine ⟨xbar, fun j => ?_, le_rfl⟩
      show g j xbar ≤ g j xbar + (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ) j * T
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        rw [Pi.single_eq_same]
        linarith [hTpos]
      · rw [Pi.single_eq_of

name: mult_strong_duality_convex_slater
doc:
**多变量-多约束零间隙（强对偶）**：与 `mult_slater_multiplier_exists` 同假设下，
存在 `λᵢ ≥ 0` 使拉格朗日函数的下确界恰等于原问题最优值 `f x̄`，且给出全局下界。

证明：乘子不等式给出 `f x̄ ≤ ⨅ x, L(x, λ)`；另一方面
`⨅ x, L(x, λ) ≤ L(x̄, λ) = f x̄ + ∑ λᵢ gᵢ x̄ ≤ f x̄`（`λᵢ ≥ 0`、`gᵢ x̄ ≤ 0`）两侧夹紧。
stmt:
theorem mult_strong_duality_convex_slater {m : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {g : Fin m → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) (hg : ∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (g i))
    {xbar : ℝ} (hfeas : ∀ i, g i xbar ≤ 0)
    (hopt : ∀ y, (∀ i, g i y ≤ 0) → f xbar ≤ f y)
    (hslater : ∃ x₀, ∀ i, g i x₀ < 0) :
    ∃ lam : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) ∧
      (⨅ x, (f x + ∑ i, lam i * g i x)) = f xbar ∧
      ∀ x, f xbar ≤ f x + ∑ i, lam i * g i x
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam, hmult⟩ := mult_slater_multiplier_exists hf hg hfeas hopt hslater
  refine ⟨lam, hlam, ?_, hmult⟩
  have hle : f xbar ≤ ⨅ x, (f x + ∑ i, lam i * g i x) := le_ciInf (fun x => hmult x)
  have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range (fun x : ℝ => f x + ∑ i, lam i * g i x)) :=
    ⟨f xbar, by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact hmult x⟩
  have hge : (⨅ x, (f x + ∑ i, lam i * g i x)) ≤ f xbar := by
    have h1 := ciInf_le hbdd xbar
    have h2 : (∑ i, lam i * g i xbar) ≤ 0 :=
      Finset.sum_nonpos (fun i _ => mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hlam i) (hfeas i))
    linarith
  exact le_antisymm hge hle

end Lattice

name: IsStrictLocalMin.toIsLocalMin
doc: 严格局部极小 ⟹ 局部极小（把球邻域改写为 `IsLocalMin` 的滤子形式）。
stmt:
theorem IsStrictLocalMin.toIsLocalMin {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (h : IsStrictLocalMin f x) :
    IsLocalMin f x
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hmin⟩ := h
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hδ] with y hy
  by_cases hyx : y = x
  · subst hyx; exact le_rfl
  · refine le_of_lt (hmin y hyx ?_)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hy
    exact hy

name: kkt_deriv_quadratic
doc: 二次目标 f(x) = a/2·x² + b·x 的导数：a·x + b。
stmt:
theorem kkt_deriv_quadratic (a b x : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun y : ℝ => a / 2 * y ^ 2 + b * y) x = a * x + b
proof:
by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a / 2 * y ^ 2) (a / 2 * (2 * x)) x := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 2).const_mul (a / 2)
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => b * y) b x := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul b
  have h := h1.add h2
  rw [h.deriv]
  ring

name: quadratic_unconstrained_stationary
doc: 二次目标的**无约束驻点**：a ≠ 0 时 f'(x) = 0 ⟺ x = −b/a。
stmt:
theorem quadratic_unconstrained_stationary (a b x : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    deriv (fun y : ℝ => a / 2 * y ^ 2 + b * y) x = 0 ↔ x = -b / a
proof:
by
  rw [kkt_deriv_quadratic]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx : a * x = -b := by linarith
    calc x = a * x / a := by rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ x ha]
      _ = -b / a := by rw [hx]
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    have h1 : a * (-b / a) = -b := by
      rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ (-b) ha]
    rw [h1]
    ring

name: quadratic_kkt
doc:
**二次问题的 KKT 完整刻画**：c ≠ 0 时 KKT 系统 ⟺ 两个互斥分支——
**非活跃**（c·x < d，a·x + b = 0，λ = 0：约束不起作用，KKT 退化为无约束驻点）
或**活跃**（c·x = d，x = d/c，λ = −(a·x+b)/c ≥ 0）。

（纯代数等价，对 a 的符号无要求；全局最优性见 `quadratic_kkt_minimal`。a ≠ 0 时
第一分支的 `a·x + b = 0` 等价于 `x = −b/a`。）
stmt:
theorem quadratic_kkt (a b c d x lam : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    IsKKTQuad a b c d x lam ↔
      (c * x < d ∧ a * x + b = 0 ∧ lam = 0) ∨
      (c * x = d ∧ x = d / c ∧ lam = -(a * x + b) / c ∧ 0 ≤ lam)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hfeas, hstat, hlam, hcs⟩
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hfeas with hlt | heq
    · have hlam0 : lam = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hcs with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h (by linarith)
      refine Or.inl ⟨hlt, ?_, hlam0⟩
      rw [hlam0] at hstat
      linarith
    · have hlc : lam * c = -(a * x + b) := by linarith
      have hlam' : lam = -(a * x + b) / c := (eq_div_iff_mul_eq hc).mpr hlc
      have hx : x = d / c := (eq_div_iff_mul_eq hc).mpr (by rw [mul_comm]; exact heq)
      exact Or.inr ⟨heq, hx, hlam', hlam⟩
  · rintro (⟨hlt, hstat0, hlam0⟩ | ⟨heq, hx, hlam, hlam0⟩)
    · refine ⟨le_of_lt hlt, ?_, le_of_eq hlam0.symm, by rw [hlam0]; ring⟩
      rw [hlam0, hstat0]
      ring
    · subst hx
      have hlc : lam * c = -(a * (d / c) + b) := (eq_div_iff_mul_eq hc).mp hlam
      refine ⟨le_of_eq heq, ?_, hlam0, by rw [heq]; ring⟩
      rw [hlc]
      ring

name: quadratic_kkt_minimal
doc:
**二次问题的 KKT 充分性（凸情形）**：a > 0 且 x 满足 KKT ⟹ x 是可行域
{y | c·y ≤ d} 上的**全局极小点**。

证明：由驻点 a·x + b = −λc 得恒等式
    f(y) − f(x) = (y − x)·(a/2·(y − x) − λc) = a/2·(y−x)² − λ·(c·(y−x))。
若 λ = 0，第一项非负；若 λ > 0，互补松弛给出 c·x = d，故 c·y ≤ d = c·x
即 c·(y−x) ≤ 0，第二项亦非负。
stmt:
theorem quadratic_kkt_minimal (a b c d x lam : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hkkt : IsKKTQuad a b c d x lam) :
    ∀ y : ℝ, c * y ≤ d → a / 2 * x ^ 2 + b * x ≤ a / 2 * y ^ 2 + b * y
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨hfeas, hstat, hlam, hcs⟩ := hkkt
  intro y hy
  have hstat' : a * x + b = -lam * c := by linarith
  have hfact : a / 2 * y ^ 2 + b * y - (a / 2 * x ^ 2 + b * x)
      = (y - x) * (a / 2 * (y - x) - lam * c) := by
    have h1 : a / 2 * (y + x) + b = a / 2 * (y - x) - lam * c := by
      have h2 : a / 2 * (y + x) + b = a / 2 * (y - x) + (a * x + b) := by ring
      rw [h2, hstat']; ring
    have h3 : a / 2 * y ^ 2 + b * y - (a / 2 * x ^ 2 + b * x)
        = (y - x) * (a / 2 * (y + x) + b) := by ring
    rw [h3, h1]
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (y - x) * (a / 2 * (y - x) - lam * c) := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlam with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0]
      have h2 : (y - x) * (a / 2 * (y - x) - 0 * c) = a / 2 * (y - x) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [h2]
      exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
    · have hcxd : c * x - d = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hcs).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hpos)
      have hle : c * (y - x) ≤ 0 := by
        have : c * y ≤ c * x := by linarith [hy, hcxd]
        linarith
      have h1 : lam * (c * (y - x)) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hpos) hle
      have h2 : (y - x) * (a / 2 * (y - x) - lam * c)
          = a / 2 * (y - x) ^ 2 - lam * (c * (y - x)) := by ring
      rw [h2]
      have h3 : 0 ≤ a / 2 * (y - x) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
      linarith
  rw [← hfact] at hnonneg
  linarith

name: deriv_affine
doc: 仿射函数 g(x) = c·x − d 的导数等于 c。
stmt: theorem deriv_affine (c d x : ℝ) : deriv (fun y : ℝ => c * y - d) x = c
proof:
by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => c * y - d) c x := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul c).sub (hasDerivAt_const x d)
  exact h.deriv

name: licq_one_dim
doc: **一维 LICQ 判据**：LICQ ⟺ 约束函数的导函数处处非零（⟺ c ≠ 0）。
stmt:
theorem licq_one_dim (c d : ℝ) :
    LICQOneDim c ↔ ∀ x : ℝ, deriv (fun y : ℝ => c * y - d) x ≠ 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hc x
    rw [deriv_affine]
    exact hc
  · intro h
    have h0 := h 0
    rwa [deriv_affine] at h0

name: licq_one_dim_multiplier_unique
doc: **LICQ ⟹ 乘子唯一**：一维仿射约束下驻点方程 f'(x) + λ·c = 0 的乘子唯一。
stmt:
theorem licq_one_dim_multiplier_unique (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c x : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (lam₁ lam₂ : ℝ) (h₁ : deriv f x + lam₁ * c = 0) (h₂ : deriv f x + lam₂ * c = 0) :
    lam₁ = lam₂
proof:
by
  have h : (lam₁ - lam₂) * c = 0 := by linarith
  have hz : lam₁ - lam₂ = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right hc
  linarith

name: kkt_one_dim_inactive_stationary
doc:
**衔接 RealStationarity**：一维 KKT 的非活跃分支给出 f'(x) = 0——
正是 P0 的标量驻点条件（约束不活跃时 KKT 退化为无约束驻点）。
stmt:
theorem kkt_one_dim_inactive_stationary (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c d x lam : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hkkt : KKTOneDim f c d x lam) (hinactive : c * x < d) :
    deriv f x = 0
proof:
by
  rcases (kkt_one_dim_complete f c d x lam hc).mp hkkt with h | ⟨heq, -⟩
  · exact h.2.2
  · exact absurd heq (ne_of_lt hinactive)

name: contDiff_two_gives_interval_hypotheses
doc:
**`ContDiffOn ℝ 2` 展开为区间光滑性假设包**（把 `RealKKTSecondOrder` 的显式假设
`hf_cont`/`hf_diff`/`hf'_cont` 以及「`f'` 的导数是 `f''`」一次性全部变成定理）。

证明：
  · `hf_cont`：`ContDiffOn.continuousOn`；
  · `hf_diff`：`ContDiffOn.differentiableOn`（`1 ≤ 2`）；
  · `hf'_cont`：`ContDiffOn.continuousOn_iteratedDerivWithin`（`1 ≤ 2`，`UniqueDiffOn`）后
    用 `iteratedDerivWithin_one` 与开区间 `UniqueDiffWithinAt` 化为 `deriv f`；
  · `hf''`：`ContDiffOn.differentiableOn_iteratedDerivWithin`（`1 < 2`）给出
    `deriv f` 在区间上可导，再用 `DifferentiableOn.differentiableAt`（开区间是邻域）取 `HasDerivAt`。
stmt:
theorem contDiff_two_gives_interval_hypotheses (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ))) :
    ContinuousOn f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)) ∧
    ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ),
      HasDerivAt (deriv f) (deriv (deriv f) z) z)
proof:
by
  set I : Set ℝ := Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ) with hI
  have hIopen : IsOpen I := isOpen_Ioo
  have huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ I := hI ▸ uniqueDiffOn_Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)
  have hxmem : x ∈ I := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hnhds : I ∈ 𝓝 x := hIopen.mem_nhds hxmem
                                                                            
  have hdw : ∀ z ∈ I, derivWithin f I z = deriv f z := fun z hz =>
    derivWithin_of_mem_nhds (hIopen.mem_nhds hz)
  have h1eq : ∀ z ∈ I, deriv f z = iteratedDerivWithin 1 f I z := fun z hz => by
    rw [iteratedDerivWithin_one (huniq z hz), hdw z hz]
  refine ⟨hf.continuousOn, hf.differentiableOn (by norm_num), ?_, ?_⟩
  ·                     
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (iteratedDerivWithin 1 f I) I :=
      hf.continuousOn_iteratedDerivWithin (by norm_num) huniq
    exact h1.congr h1eq
  ·                                           
    intro z hz
    have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin 1 f I) I :=
      hf.differentiableOn_iteratedDerivWithin (by norm_num) huniq
    have hzI : I ∈ 𝓝 z := hIopen.mem_nhds hz
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin 1 f I) z := h2.differentiableAt hzI
    have hev : deriv f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] iteratedDerivWithin 1 f I := by
      filter_upwards [hzI] with w hw
      exact h1eq w hw
    have hd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv f) z := hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    refine (hd'.hasDerivAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hzI] with w hw
    show deriv f w = deriv f w
    rfl

name: second_order_sufficient_of_contDiff
doc:
**二阶充分条件（单假设版 / WP6 升级）**：把 `second_order_sufficient` 的四条区间假设
（`hf_cont`、`hf_diff`、`hf'_cont`、以及 `f''` 的可微性）**合并为一条
`ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Ioo (x−δ) (x+δ))`**，其余保留 `f'' > 0` 于区间与驻点条件。

结论与 `second_order_sufficient` **完全一致**（不弱化）：`x` 是严格局部极小。

证明：`contDiff_two_gives_interval_hypotheses` 一次性产出原版所需的全部区间假设，
再调用 `second_order_sufficient`。
stmt:
theorem second_order_sufficient_of_contDiff (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf''_pos : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ), 0 < deriv (deriv f) z)
    (hstat : deriv f x = 0) : IsStrictLocalMin f x
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨hc, hd, hdc, _⟩ := contDiff_two_gives_interval_hypotheses f x δ hδ hf
  exact second_order_sufficient f x δ hδ hc hd hdc hf''_pos hstat

name: second_order_necessary_of_contDiff
doc:
**二阶必要条件（单假设版 / WP6 升级）**：把 `second_order_necessary` 的**四条**区间假设
（`hf_cont`、`hf_diff`、`hf'_cont`）以及**点条件** `ContinuousAt (deriv (deriv f)) x`
**全部**合并为一条 `ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Ioo (x−δ) (x+δ))`。

结论与 `second_order_necessary` **完全一致**（不弱化）：`0 ≤ f''(x)`。

证明要点：`ContDiffOn ℝ 2` 给出 `iteratedDerivWithin 2 f I` 在 `I` 上连续
（`ContDiffOn.continuousOn_iteratedDerivWithin`，取 `m = 2 ≤ 2`）；而在开区间 `I` 上
`iteratedDerivWithin 2 f I = deriv (deriv f)`（`iteratedDerivWithin_succ` +
`iteratedDerivWithin_one` + `derivWithin_of_mem_nhds`），故 `deriv (deriv f)` 在 `x`
连续——**原本那条点假设 `hf''_cont` 由 `ContDiffOn` 免费产出**。

**升级性质**：这是**纯粹的假设合并**，不引入任何更强的新假设，也不弱化结论。
stmt:
theorem second_order_necessary_of_contDiff (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hmin : IsLocalMin f x)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ))) :
    0 ≤ deriv (deriv f) x
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨hc, hd, hdc, _⟩ := contDiff_two_gives_interval_hypotheses f x δ hδ hf
                                                                         
                                                             
  set I : Set ℝ := Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ) with hI
  have hIopen : IsOpen I := isOpen_Ioo
  have huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ I := hI ▸ uniqueDiffOn_Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)
  have hxmem : x ∈ I := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hcont2 : ContinuousOn (iteratedDerivWithin 2 f I) I :=
    hf.continuousOn_iteratedDerivWithin (by norm_num) huniq
                                                        
  have heq : ∀ z ∈ I, iteratedDerivWithin 2 f I z = deriv (deriv f) z := fun z hz => by
    have hzI : I ∈ 𝓝 z := hIopen.mem_nhds hz
                                                                                   
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, iteratedDerivWithin_succ (huniq z hz)]
    have hfun : iteratedDerivWithin 1 f I =ᶠ[𝓝 z] deriv f := by
      filter_upwards [hzI] with w hw
      rw [iteratedDerivWithin_one (huniq w hw), derivWithin_of_mem_nhds (hIopen.mem_nhds hw)]
    rw [derivWithin_of_mem_nhds hzI, hfun.deriv_eq]
  have hev : iteratedDerivWithin 2 f I =ᶠ[𝓝 x] deriv (deriv f) := by
    filter_upwards [hIopen.mem_nhds hxmem] with z hz
    exact heq z hz
  have hcontat : ContinuousAt (deriv (deriv f)) x :=
    (hcont2.continuousAt (hIopen.mem_nhds hxmem)).congr hev
  exact second_order_necessary f x δ hδ hmin hc hd hdc hcontat

name: exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos_kkt
doc:
`g` 在 `x` 处连续且 `0 < g x` ⟹ 存在充分小的盒子使 `g` 在盒内严格为正。

⭐ 证明：把本文件第四节的 `exists_box_of_continuousAt_neg` 应用于 `−g`
（`g x > 0` ⟺ `(−g) x < 0`），再把结论的符号翻回来。**复用已有引擎，无新数学。**

⚠⚠ **命名订正（2026-09-24）**：本定理原名为 `exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos`，
**与 `RealSaddlePoint.lean:162` 的同名定理冲突**（**同一 `Lattice` 扁平命名空间**）——
⚠ **且 `RealSaddlePoint.lean:2` 自己 import 本文件 ⟹ 该 root 模块无法被 import**
（**内核实证**：`environment already contains 'Lattice.exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos'
from RealKKTSecondOrder`）。
⭐ **引入时间**：`RealSaddlePoint` 侧的该定理出自 `985a57b`（wave 8）；
**本侧是 B249 `2e10f29` 才追加的** ⟹ **故由本侧改名**（加 `_kkt` 后缀）。
⚠ **两侧陈述**同型但**不是同一个引理**（本侧走 `−g` 引擎），**故改名而非删除**。
stmt:
theorem exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos_kkt (g : ℝ → ℝ) {x δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hg : ContinuousAt g x) (hpos : g x > 0) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η ≤ δ ∧ ∀ z, |z - x| < η → 0 < g z
proof:
by
  have hgn : ContinuousAt (fun z => -g z) x :=
    (continuous_neg.continuousAt).comp hg
  have hneg : (fun z => -g z) x < 0 := by simpa using hpos
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηδ, hbox⟩ := exists_box_of_continuousAt_neg (fun z => -g z) hδ hgn hneg
  exact ⟨η, hη, hηδ, fun z hz => by have := hbox z hz; linarith⟩

name: second_order_sufficient_pointwise
doc:
⭐ **点式二阶充分条件**：`f`/`f'` 在 `(x−δ, x+δ)` 上连续可微，
`f''` **在 `x` 处连续**且 `f''(x) > 0`（**点条件**），`f'(x) = 0`
⟹ `x` 是 `f` 的**严格局部极小点**。

**与第七节的对比**：结论相同，但把第七节的**区间**假设 `∀z ∈ I, 0 < f'' z`
降为**点**假设 `0 < f'' x`（外加 `f''` 在 `x` 的点连续性）⟹ **严格更弱**。

证明：`exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos_kkt` 把点正性转成盒内一致正性（半径取 `min δ η`），
再调用第三节的 `second_order_sufficient`。
stmt:
theorem second_order_sufficient_pointwise (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hf_cont : ContinuousOn f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf'_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf''_cont : ContinuousAt (deriv (deriv f)) x)
    (hf''_pos : 0 < deriv (deriv f) x)
    (hstat : deriv f x = 0) : IsStrictLocalMin f x
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨η, hηpos, hηδ, hbox⟩ :=
    exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos_kkt (deriv (deriv f)) hδ hf''_cont hf''_pos
                                  
  have hsubset : Ioo (x - η) (x + η) ⊆ Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [mem_Ioo] at ht ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
  exact second_order_sufficient f x η hηpos (hf_cont.mono hsubset) (hf_diff.mono hsubset)
    (hf'_cont.mono hsubset) (fun z hz => hbox z (by
      rw [abs_lt]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hz.1], by linarith [hz.2]⟩)) hstat
